卡姆兹·熔环.who: 魔族炎角熔环氏的骑手。约158年他跳下西陆蓝焰火山带的火口，扣住撞死父亲的熔角犀王的角根摔了三天，掰断它半只角，骑上了它的背，名字从此凝住，约166年走到了传奇。炽缰是熔环氏的人先叫开的。

at.text: 约158年卡姆兹在火口山上驯服了犀王，约166年在那里走到了传奇。169年他领着犀群踏过接缝。172年金穗月第三夜，犀王撞开白冠城的西门，他跳上门顶甩开红链，后头的炎角顺着火弧冲进了城。
西门撞开以后他没有追诺伦去赤原，留下守着这一道刚撞开的门，等犀王肩上的裂口长好。白冠城那几年在炎角手里。
233年长垒开工，墙一段一段立起来。236年坠叶月魔潮突至，同一天北段有缺口，南段破了第三道，他骑着犀王走在炎角诸氏的最前头，撞向长垒中段一处还没合上的豁口。

quotes: 再撞一回。你把帐子挪远些，这回它要往左偏。
他没有逃。你再把那一天说一遍。
卡姆兹·熔环.note: 纷争纪时段_二 凡世至强炽缰（第1927到1975行，拼好的页），凝名约158、到传奇约166；172年西门照第183行和条目往后的事；5到6张源稿只有留守西门一句和雅德维加条“白冠城那几年在炎角手里”；第7张照第1115行和条目236年那一段，写到冲豁口以前。

芙琪·铃尾.who: 风啸高原铃尾家的兔耳信使。181年初雪月她满身系铃往西跑了九天九夜，引开追皇帝车子的追兵，最后踩碎冰瀑落进深潭，名字凝在那一跳上，约214年走到了传奇。铃在别处是风啸牧带上的人先叫开的。

at.text: 西征那些年芙琪在牧带和西征军各营之间送信。从苔阶城路过时，阿诺尔德要给她一盏灯，她嫌重，只要了一小截防水的灯芯缝在信袋边上。约214年她走到了传奇。229年初雪月，东撤的令要送进毒沼西边几座还没收拢的营里。

quotes: 我先到。你要是赢了，晚饭里那块甜面包给你。
芙琪·铃尾.note: 纷争纪时段_二 凡世至强铃在别处（第1975行起），181年那九天照凝名伟业和第585行；第6张照条目往后的事和第879、928行，写到毒沼口以前。她凝名在第5张的年份，表上只在第6张，按说明写第6张这一段。

阿诺尔德·渚灯.who: 星湖边渔家出身的人族。约212年他摸黑顺着苔阶城心横倒的辉塔爬到塔尖，点起一盏渔灯，破开那一里的夜，名字从此凝住，约228年走到了传奇。塔脊上的灯是顺着那一道亮进城的西征军先叫开的。

at.text: 约212年阿诺尔德在塔尖点起渔灯，联军顺着那一道亮进了苔阶城。213年春汛灌满倒塔，他守着塔腹东头替困住的两边的人照路。229年东撤，他最后一个出城，把城门钥匙插在锁眼里没有拔。
东撤以后他守长垒南段第三道的段门，夜里墙上要看清什么先叫他，不打仗的时候住在段门上头一间窗子朝东的空屋里。约228年他走到了传奇。236年坠叶月魔潮突至，第三道上头的天先黑了。

quotes: 你从星湖来？东岸那座桥补好了没有，我走的时候还缺一块板。
阿诺尔德·渚灯.note: 纷争纪时段_二 凡世至强塔脊上的灯（第2025行起）；第6张照第870、906行和条目凝名伟业、往后的事；第7张照条目势力和位阶两行、第1105行，写到段门点灯以前。到传奇约228年落在第6张的年份里，我写进第7张那一段开头，主会话要挪回第6张也行。

雅德维加·银坡.who: 白冠城北面栗岭种栗子的银坡家女儿，人族。172年金穗月她领北城四千多人上岭，在岭口横枪守了三天三夜，满岭栗叶翻白压退火线，名字从此凝住，约220年走到了传奇。翻银是岭上种栗子的人先叫开的。

at.text: 雅德维加守着栗岭朝南的岭口。白冠城那几年在炎角手里，岭口是岭北人家跟它之间的头一道坎。她一年一年守下去，约220年走到了传奇。
233年长垒开工，她去了中段，守一处还没合上的豁口，回岭的时候照旧睡在自家栗仓的阁楼上。236年坠叶月魔潮突至，天上七头真龙在跟魔潮的后阵缠斗，那一处豁口上只有她一个。

quotes: 你还能赶吗？手给我看看，缰绳都勒进肉里了。
今晚不住。岭外还有一辆车呢。
雅德维加·银坡.note: 纷争纪时段_二 凡世至强翻银（第1879行起），位阶一行写约220年走到顶、守栗岭朝南的岭口；第7张照势力一行、往后的事和第1115行，写到犀王撞进豁口以前。

伊拉瑟.who: 夜魔，魔族。约205年她站在苔阶城心那一根倒下的辉塔上，把方圆十里的正午拉成了夜，七头真龙飞进去辨不清上下，绕了三天才出来。正午之夜是苔阶城里白天点灯的魔族先叫开的。

at.text: 往后七年苔阶城的正午都是黑的，伊拉瑟那一部住在倒塔底下那几条街上。约212年渔灯点亮，她丢了城。213年春汛她回塔腹接困在水里的同族，跟阿诺尔德隔着一盏灯放过人。229年初雪月她在毒沼口截断了芙琪的风路。
236年坠叶月她跟着茨维娅的魔潮到了南段第三道，把夜从段门往南北两头铺开，三百里的墙一齐落进黑里。第三道破了以后，那一片黑在第三道上头停了三天。
230年开春以后西边十三座城又是魔族的了，魔族整营一点一点挪进城。伊拉瑟跟着大队走，她认的家一直是苔阶城倒塔底下那几条阴凉的街。
这些年她在长垒南段外头魔族的阵里。1021年，南段外头的那一阵里有她，烽塔下的那一位加兹也在。

quotes: 把灯偏一点，好吗？你照着路就好，别照我。
伊拉瑟.note: 纷争纪时段_二 凡世至强正午之夜（第2077行起）；第6张照凝名伟业后两段和往后的事、第870、879行；第7张照第1105行和条目236年那两段；8到9张源稿没专门记她，照补卷_08 第86、87行（230年开春十三座城又归魔族，魔族一点一点挪进城）和条目势力一行；第10张照纷争纪时段_三 托卡条第1590行和条目1021年那一段，写到托卡冲阵以前。

乌兹格.who: 魔族里身量最大的那一路。约270年墙西一道谷口外，一头赤火真龙从天上栽下来，他钻到龙胸底下拿肩膀顶了三天三夜，一营八百多人从龙腹底下爬了出去。龙下之肩是那一营的人先叫开的。

at.text: 约270年墙西一场大仗里，乌兹格在龙胸底下顶了三天三夜，最后一个人出去他才松肩。龙落了地，往后慢慢化成墙西的一道长石脊，北头留着两个肩宽的凹。
往后几百年，他照旧睡在帐篷外头，大营挪到哪里他跟到哪里。挪地方的时候，从龙底下出来的人和他们的后人先挑一块平地留给他。他替大伙搬东西，从来不要酬。
1020年他在哈法斯座下的营里。炎潮月斯卡索倒下以后几天，南段尽头往南那一片坡还在翻，草根朝上，帐子挂在倒过来的土里，他跟着营困在坡当中。

quotes: 我侧一点。这样你出得来吗？
往有风的地方跑。到了那里，你再叫我。
乌兹格.note: 纷争纪时段_二 凡世至强龙下之肩（第2181行起）；第7张照第1117行、补卷_73 第360行；8到9张照条目往后的事第一段和势力一行；第10张照条目1020年那一段开头、补卷_73 第42行，写到往坡外扔人以前。龙名伊萨弗昂照补卷_73 第354行不让当地人报，who 里没写。

索克尔·深井.who: 深井一支的矮人工兵，在古伦手底下修长垒。约262年开春，春汛连着冰排和火筏冲神渡水门，他跳进河心一夜打下一排桩，一锤一根，水门地基一块没走。河心之桩是河岸工棚里听了一夜锤声的人叫开的。

at.text: 约262年开春索克尔在河心打下那一排桩。263年春汛，他带人拆开卡在旧桩前的火筏，把两岸困住的人接了回来。296年合龙，他在水门口听了一整夜远处的欢呼，第二天照常潜下去摸桩。
往后他守着神渡水门，河道改过几回样子，工兵换了一批又一批。他教出来的锤法从一排桩用到了整座水门，深井的工兵下水以前都先敲三下。
墙上有了炮，水门护门的术式和守军扛着整段河道的压力。索克尔照旧守在神渡水门，别人不敢下的深水他先下。

quotes: 先敲三下。底下有人，他才知道你来了。
索克尔·深井.note: 纷争纪时段_二 凡世至强河心之桩（第2129行起）；第7张照第1116行和条目往后的事；8到12张照条目往后的事和补卷_73 第216、217行；第13张照补卷_73 第217行“1051到8800年”那一段开头和位阶一行，写到3290年余波以前。

妲格玛.who: 长垒南段的传奇守将，墙这一边记得她叫无定处妲格玛。她是哪里人、名字凝在哪一件事上，没有记下来。

at.text: 妲格玛守在长垒南段。340年起对面多了一张弓，十年才射一箭，346年南段最稳的守将缇里安死在垒后第三层。她知道有这么一个射手，在墙上从不在一处停过一口气。

妲格玛.note: 没有自己的条目。纷争纪时段_三 人物法隆第1609行和裁定锁、补卷_09 战役｜南段的箭第42行与裁定锁；总表第237行。凝名年份、族、样子源稿都不给。

法埃尔.who: 长垒南段的传奇守将，墙这一边记得他叫隙间的弦法埃尔。他是哪里人、名字凝在哪一件事上，没有记下来。

at.text: 法埃尔守在长垒南段。对面那张十年才射一箭的弓，346年、356年各射落一位守将，专找自以为站在安全处的人。他干脆不上垒，只在夜里巡。

法埃尔.note: 没有自己的条目。纷争纪时段_三 人物法隆第1609行、补卷_09 战役｜南段的箭第42行；总表第238行。凝名年份、族、样子源稿都不给。

鲁达赫.who: 魔族炎角的有名者，传奇之名爆垣。341年领魔潮扑长垒中段的时候他已经凝了名，凝在哪一年、哪一件事上，没有记下来。

at.text: 341年坠叶月，魔潮从天边漫过来扑长垒中段斯滕家的口子，魔潮里有一团火跟别的不一样，走在最前面，那就是鲁达赫。那一天的战报只写了有名者在场，墙这一边不知道他叫什么。

鲁达赫.note: 没有自己的条目。纷争纪时段_三 主线鹿角纪年第153、180行与裁定锁第195行；补卷_83 史诗战灯的年月第28、31行（角上燃金火的炎角巨角，没搬进中文栏）；总表第239行。往后不给，at 只写到这一张。

falls.where: 长垒中段一处没合上的豁口
falls.how: 犀王叫雅德维加一枪捅倒，堵死了豁口，卡姆兹在犀背上跟她打到天黑。犀王的脊骨断了，他把最后一股熔火绞成一轮火，要把豁口往东烧穿，她把一口气吐进风里，火轮翻了回来。他还攥着链子要把死了的兽再勒起来，不肯撒手，火柱合拢，把两个人一起吞了。
falls.name: 火轮
falls.light: deep red dusk, the only light the towering wheel of molten fire he is raising, glowing white-hot at its core and throwing his shadow back across the broken wall
falls.camera: low and close behind his left shoulder on the beast's back, looking up past him at the wheel of fire, tilted hard to the right
falls.text: Scene: dusk at the end of a long day, a half-built breach in a great white-stone wall, the stone on both sides glowing red-hot. The whole lower half of the picture is the back of a vast dead rhinoceros-beast lying on its side across the breach, its armoured hide cracked and glowing like a cooling forge, its single horn broken off halfway; the frame cuts off its head and tail. Standing on the beast's spine, on the right of the picture, seen from behind at three-quarter, is the chain-rider, a towering demon man with copper-red skin, short dark-blue hair, two horns sweeping straight back from his brow with molten-white lines at their roots, orange-gold slit eyes in the half of his face we see. He wears a black iron cuirass that leaves his shoulders bare, an old burn scar on his left shoulder, rhino-hide wrapped around his legs. A heavy black iron chain is wound around both his forearms, and he is heaving it upward with all his weight: the chain feeds into a standing wheel of molten fire, taller than a city gate, that rises out of the beast's back and fills the upper left of the frame, its rim spitting sparks. His arms are burned and bleeding where the links bite, his face set and furious. On the left, small and hard to see inside the fire's glare, the outline of a woman with a broken spear pressing it down into the beast's hide, and a pale silver wind already bending the top of the wheel back toward him. Far behind on the wall, a row of tiny soldiers flattens itself on the stair. Embers, ash and torn chain links drift large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是天黑犀王脊骨断了、他把熔火绞成火轮要往东烧穿那一下，纷争纪时段_二 炽缰条往后的事末段（第1975行前后）和第1115行。火轮立起来有城门那么高照条目。雅德维加只露一个影子，免得跟她那一幅撞。

falls.how: 芙琪送完东撤的信，回程在毒沼口碰上伊拉瑟，那一层夜正截得断她的风路。她往亮处一跑就走得掉，可泥里那些伤兵就跟不上铃声了。她把铃一串一串甩上树梢，围着沼口跑了一夜，快天亮的时候跑完最后一圈，夜从树根合到树顶，从她胸口穿了过去。
falls.name: 沼口铃
falls.light: almost total darkness, the only light a faint grey line of coming dawn at the far edge of the marsh and the dull glint of copper bells in the treetops
falls.camera: from waist height among the reeds, looking across the bog at her as she runs past from left to right, a little tilted
falls.text: Scene: the last hour before dawn in early winter, at the mouth of a poisonous marsh at the foot of a dark ridge. The whole sky and the upper half of the frame are filled with a thick black night that is not natural, pressing down like a heavy curtain, swallowing the tops of dead rotten trees from the roots upward; on the right edge, blackness is already climbing a tree trunk and closing over its branches. Strings of small copper bells hang from the bare branches all around the clearing, dozens of them, swaying. In the middle ground, running from left to right along the edge of the bog, is the bell-runner, a slight girl of eighteen with short peach-colored hair, pale violet eyes, two long white rabbit ears laid back with a small peach tuft on the tip of the left one, a cloak that reaches only to her waist, copper bells sewn along her hems and around her ankle bands, mud to the knees and scratches across her cheek. Her right arm is flung up and back, letting go of one last string of bells toward a high branch, her face toward us, open-mouthed, breathing hard and fierce. Behind her feet a faint trail of pale blue-green wind marks is going out one step at a time. In the near foreground, low in the mud, the backs of two wounded soldiers crawl toward firmer ground, following the sound. Far away on the left, a single wagon with its lantern unlit waits at the dark edge of the reeds. Drops of muddy water and loose reed seeds hang large and blurred in the corners.
falls.note: 画的是最后一圈甩铃那一下，夜正从树根往上合，还没穿过她，纷争纪时段_二 铃在别处条往后的事第二段和第879行。死法落在克制上照条目（伊拉瑟截得断风路），伊拉瑟不入画，只画压下来的夜。十八岁凝名，看着十八，按成年画。

falls.where: 长垒南段第三道的段门
falls.how: 伊拉瑟把第三道上头的天拉黑，阿诺尔德站上段门点灯，三回剖开黑幕，第三回把灯贴在胸口，给往第四道去的人照出两条退路。第四回灯没有点着，灯芯在指缝里散成了灰，伊拉瑟从夜里走上门顶合拢黑幕，段门往外倒，他连着门拱落进了夜里。
falls.name: 段门灯
falls.light: black night pressing in from every side, the only light a warm glow leaking from the man's chest and a spark from the flint in his hands, two thin lines of light running away along the broken walls
falls.camera: from just below the top of the gate, looking up at him against the black sky, the stones of the arch filling the lower frame, tilted left
falls.text: Scene: before dawn on a long white-stone wall in autumn, on top of a tall gatehouse arch, under a sky that has been dragged into a solid starless black. The black is not an ordinary night: it fills the whole upper frame like a heavy cloth folding down over the parapet, and at the top edge of the picture its folds are closing in. The gatehouse beneath him is already leaning outward, cracks running through the arch, a section of battlement broken away. Standing alone on top of the arch, in the middle of the frame, facing toward us at three-quarter, is the lamp-keeper, a tall human man with lake-blue hair tucked behind his ears, amber-brown eyes, a pale scar at the tip of his left eyebrow, wearing a worn old blue coat. His coat front has gone thin and glassy, and through his ribs a warm glow shines out, so that his chest is the brightest thing in the picture. In both hands, held close, is a small brass ship's lantern; he is striking a flint at its wick, and the wick is crumbling into grey ash between his fingers. His face is calm and intent, like a fisherman lighting a lamp on his boat. Two thin lines of soft light run away from his feet along the broken walls on either side, and far down along them, small, a column of retreating soldiers is moving away into the distance, a little light caught on their cloaks. Flakes of ash and drifting stone dust float large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是第四回打火、灯芯散成灰那一下，前三回的光还从胸口透出来，纷争纪时段_二 塔脊上的灯条往后的事末两段、第1105行。伊拉瑟不画人，只画合下来的黑幕。死法照条目落在燃尽上。

falls.where: 长垒中段一处没合上的豁口
falls.how: 豁口上只她一个，她一枪捅倒犀王堵死了豁口，跟卡姆兹在犀背上打到天黑。卡姆兹要把豁口往东烧穿，她的枪折了半截，她把剩下的枪杆压进犀甲，把最后一口气吐进风里，中段十几里的风一齐转向，火柱折回豁口合拢，把她和卡姆兹一起吞了。
falls.name: 回风
falls.light: the red of dusk and a towering column of fire on the right, a cold silver-white wind light sweeping in from the left and lighting her hair and cloak
falls.camera: from the broken wall above and to the left, looking down onto the beast's back at her, steeply tilted
falls.text: Scene: dusk on the same day, the same breach in a half-built white-stone wall, seen from above. Across the lower part of the frame lies the enormous armoured back of a dead rhinoceros-beast wedged into the breach, its hide cracked and glowing red, its spine buckled; the frame cuts off its head. On the right a great column of molten fire rises from the beast's back and out of the frame at the top, and it is bending, its upper half folding back over toward the breach as if pushed by a giant hand. In the center of the picture, kneeling on the beast's back with her left knee down and her body leaning forward, is the chestnut-ridge spearwoman, a tall human woman with pale gold hair tied at the nape of her neck and coming loose in the wind, teal-green eyes, a small silver leaf earring in her right ear, a short teal cloak torn at the hem. Both her hands are on the lower half of a broken green-shafted spear, driving it straight down into the gaps of the rhino's armour; the spear head and upper half are gone. Her face is turned up toward the fire, lips parted, breathing out, and a pale silver-white wind pours past her from the left, carrying a storm of silver-white leaves across the fire. Her arms and cheek are burned, blood on her knuckles. In the deep right background, half hidden in the fire's glare, the dark shape of a horned man clings to a chain. Far in the upper left, small along the wall, workers and soldiers shield their faces. Silver leaves and embers drift large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是把断枪压进犀甲、一口气吐进风里、火柱开始折回那一下，纷争纪时段_二 翻银条往后的事末段和第1115行。卡姆兹那一幅机位在他左肩后头仰拍，这一幅从断墙上俯拍，两幅岔开。银白的叶子照条目“叶背一样的银光”写，豁口在中段不在栗岭，叶子是风带来的光，主会话嫌编就删。

falls.how: 托卡一个人冲进了南段外头的敌阵，伊拉瑟把三百里的夜倒卷起来立成一堵黑墙，雷顺着黑墙往上跑。最后她把夜全收回身上，张开一对遮住整座山脊的暗翼，雷钻进翼根，顺着她颈后那一片怕光的灼痕裂开。她护着阵里的人不撤，黑翼断成两片，裹着她坠进阵心，谁先倒下没有人看见。
falls.name: 黑翼
falls.light: a blinding white bolt of lightning striking from the top of the frame, everything else drowned in black, the lightning tracing her silhouette and the edges of her wings
falls.camera: from far below on the dark slope, looking straight up at her above the ridge, the frame tilted steeply
falls.text: Scene: a stormy day turned to night over a long ridge south of a great wall, in the middle of an enemy host. Everything is black: the night has been pulled out of the ground and wrapped around one figure. In the upper half of the frame, above the ridge, a demon woman hangs in the air with a vast pair of dark wings spread wide, wings made of folded night that cover the whole ridge from edge to edge and run off both sides of the picture. She is seen from below, facing us, her chest and face turned toward us: cold white skin, long indigo-purple hair gathered over her left shoulder and blown loose, the last hand-length of it pure white, silver-white eyes with thin vertical slit pupils, a pair of slender dark horns growing above the temples and curving down close along the sides of her head so the tips point forward toward the outer corners of her eyes, a small black flame no bigger than a candle flame on each tip, giving off no light, a hooded short mail coat over a long dark dress, a black velvet band at her throat torn half away. A single huge bolt of white lightning comes down from the top edge of the frame and has just struck into the root of her right wing; from there a crack of white light is splitting along the wing toward her shoulder and round to the side of her neck, where the torn velvet band shows a pale old scar, and the right wing is breaking in two. Her face is tense, teeth bared, both hands clenched as she holds the wings open. Far below on the dark slope, small, a crowd of horned soldiers crouches under the shelter of her wings, and at the bottom edge a single tiny rider figure stands in the lightning's glare, too small to make out. Torn shreds of darkness and white sparks drift large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是雷钻进翼根、灼痕裂开、黑翼正断那一下，纷争纪时段_二 正午之夜条往后的事末段，纷争纪时段_三 托卡条第1590行。“她护着阵里的人不撤”是从条目护短和黑翼遮住整座山脊推的一句，主会话要删可删。托卡有立绘，这一批不写 who，只画成远处一个小骑手，按说明不点破谁的刀。

falls.where: 南段尽头往南翻起来的坡
falls.how: 斯卡索倒下以后几天，神血泡过的坡还在翻，乌兹格把两条胳膊伸进翻卷的地里，一把接住往下滑的人，往坡外扔，扔出去三百多个。神血泡出来的石纹咬进旧伤，草根爬上了腰，他还剩两个人没扔出去，不走。最后两个人扔出去的那一下他两条胳膊断了，坡从两边合过来，把他卷进了深处。
falls.name: 翻坡
falls.light: harsh pale daylight from a high white sky, a strange glow of warm gold from the god-soaked earth itself, long hard shadows
falls.camera: low on the outer slope below him, looking up the tilted hillside at him as he throws, horizon steeply tilted
falls.text: Scene: a summer day a few days after a god has fallen, on a hillside south of the end of a great wall. The whole hill is turning itself over: in the upper half of the frame a slope of earth has reared up toward the sky like a wave, grass roots sticking upward, torn tents and poles hanging upside down in the soil, the ground faintly glowing gold where divine blood has soaked it. The frame cuts the top of the rearing slope off. Waist-deep in the turning earth, in the center of the picture, stands the dragon-shoulder, a giant demon man eight feet tall and more, with grey-brown skin crossed by deep lines like mountain rock, two short horns spreading outward to the sides, close-cropped black hair, deep teal eyes, a square face with a crooked broken nose, thick hide wrapped over both shoulders. Grass roots have climbed up his legs to his waist; both shoulders have split open along old wounds and dark red dragon scales show inside, blood running down his arms. He is seen from the front and a little to the left, mid-throw: his right arm swung up and forward, two people, a horned man and a horned woman, just leaving his hand and flying out over our heads toward the lower slope, his left hand braced against the earth closing in. His face is calm and strained, eyes following them. Far below at the bottom of the picture, small on a gentler slope, a line of large round shields lies on the ground with figures getting up from them. Clods of earth, uprooted grass and dust float large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是扔最后两个人出去那一下，纷争纪时段_二 龙下之肩条往后的事末段、补卷_73 第42行。斯卡索的显像 god_z_butui_03 没挂，坡上是神倒下以后的神血地，祂本身不在场。最后两个人的族和男女源稿不给，我写成两个生角的人。

falls.where: 长垒中段的神渡水门底下
falls.how: 塌口那一仗的余波顺着深岩压到中段，水门底下的老桩一根接一根往上拱。索克尔把锤交给岸上的徒工，潜到最深处抱住正当中那一根，抱了一整夜，身子往下沉一寸，门就往回落一寸，他不松手。天亮以前门落回原处，河沙从他头顶合上，两条胳膊跟那一根桩长成了一块。
falls.name: 抱桩
falls.light: dark green-blue water lit from below by glowing golden-brown rock patterns along his back and along the pile, a faint pale dawn far above the surface
falls.camera: underwater, low beside the riverbed looking slightly up at him and the pile, the surface a bright ripple at the top, tilted right
falls.text: Scene: night turning toward dawn in early summer, deep under a river at the foot of a great water gate in a white-stone wall. The whole background is the underside of the gate: massive stone foundations and a forest of old stone piles rising out of the riverbed, many of them tilted and heaving upward, the riverbed bulging, sand and pebbles streaming upward in the current. Far above, through the water, the surface is a wild bright ripple, and walls of white water stand on both sides of the gate. In the center of the frame, at the very bottom of the river, a short broad dwarf in his prime has both arms wrapped around the thickest stone pile, the one in the middle, his cheek and forehead pressed to it. He is seen from the side, facing right: stocky and barrel-chested, a red-brown beard in two braids each threaded through a stone ring, grey eyes half closed, a leather work apron rolled at his waist, bare thick forearms. Along his back and his arms runs a glowing pattern of golden-brown rock veins that continues straight up the pile into the foundation, and where his arms hold it the pile is turning to the same stone as his skin. Sand is already drifting over his boots and knees. His face is calm and determined, cheeks puffed with held breath. Small in the upper left, through the water, the dark keel of a boat hangs in the air above the gate. Bubbles, sand grains and old river weed float large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是天亮以前抱着正当中那一根桩、沙开始合上那一下，纷争纪时段_二 河心之桩条往后的事末三段，补卷_73 第217行、补卷_68 第134行。死法照条目落在神性余波上，也是燃尽，how 里写他不松手。

falls.how: 对面那张弓开弓的第十七年。妲格玛知道有这么一个射手，在墙上从不在一处停过一口气，以为一直挪着就安全，那张弓专找自以为站在安全处的人，还是一箭。长垒这一边不知道射手叫什么。
falls.name: 垛间
who: the wall-warden who never stands still
falls.light: flat late-afternoon sun from the right, long shadows of the battlements across the walkway, a hard glint from far away
falls.camera: low on the wall walk ahead of her, looking back along the parapet as she strides toward us, slightly tilted
falls.text: Scene: late afternoon on the southern stretch of a vast white-stone wall that runs from one horizon to the other, the land beyond it scorched and empty. The wall walk runs diagonally from the near right of the frame into the far distance on the left, battlements casting a long row of shadows across the stone. In the middle of the walk, moving fast toward us between two merlons, is the wall-warden who never stands still, a lean, light-footed woman of about thirty, bare-headed, in a fitted half-cuirass of old wall-steel engraved with faintly glowing white script over dark leather, a single pauldron on her left shoulder, a short grey cloak and a dark red wool scarf; her ash-rose hair is in one long single braid swinging down her back, warm topaz eyes, fair skin, a thin silver cuff on the rim of her left ear; a long light spear with a narrow leaf-shaped blade is held low in one hand, the other hand trailing along the top of the parapet as she passes, her stride long and quick, the cloak swinging behind her. Her head is turned a little to the right, toward the wasteland beyond the wall, as if she has heard something. Far out across the waste on the right, three hundred paces away, there is nothing to see except one small hard point of light on a low rise, and from it a single dark arrow, already in flight, a thin straight line crossing the right third of the picture toward her, still in the air. Behind her along the wall, small, a few soldiers in the shade of a watchtower look up from their posts. Further back a squat signal tower rises from the wall. Blown dust and dry grass seed drift large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是箭在半空、她正从两个垛口之间走过那一下，纷争纪时段_三 法隆条第1609行、补卷_09 第42行。她的族、长相、兵器源稿都不给，照新添说明写成兜帽遮脸的背影一样的样子。射手看不见，只画远处一点光和一支箭。

falls.how: 对面那张弓开弓的第三十年。法埃尔干脆不上垒，只在夜里巡，那张弓等了他四个月，还是一箭。他是第三位，射手第二个月就卸了弦。
falls.name: 夜巡
falls.light: starlight only, cold blue night, the faint grey glow of the white wall above and one small hand lantern's warm circle on the ground
falls.camera: from high on the wall looking down along its foot at him walking below, the frame tilted left
falls.text: Scene: a clear cold night in late season on the southern stretch of a vast white-stone wall, no light in the sky but stars. The wall fills the left side of the frame, its pale stone face rising out of the picture at the top, battlements along the upper edge black against the stars. Along the foot of the wall, on the inside, runs a narrow dirt patrol path between the wall and a dark line of earthworks and tents, and in the middle distance, walking slowly away from us along that path, is the night-walking warden, a tall figure in a dark hooded cloak, seen from behind at three-quarter, the hood up, a long weapon wrapped in cloth slung across the back, one hand holding a small hooded hand lantern low so that its light falls only on the path in front of the boots. The walk is unhurried, the head turned a little toward the deep shadow of the wall. Far out on the right, beyond the end of the earthworks, there is only a dark empty slope under the stars, and on it nothing at all can be seen, except a single dark arrow, already in flight, a thin straight line crossing the upper right of the picture toward the lantern. Behind on the earthworks, small, a sentry by a brazier has his back turned. The thin smoke of the brazier drifts and a few frost-bitten grass blades sway large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 画的是箭在半空、他在墙脚下夜巡那一下，纷争纪时段_三 法隆条第1609行、补卷_09 第42行。族、长相源稿不给，写成兜帽背影。“布裹着的长兵器”是补的，主会话嫌编就删。四个月、第二个月卸弦照法隆条。

notes: 阿诺尔德约228年到传奇落在第6张的年份里，我写进了第7张那一段，要不要挪回第6张。
芙琪181年凝名在第5张年份，表上只从第6张起，at 只写第6张，凝名那一件只在 who 里。
鲁达赫有史诗战描写“角上燃金火的炎角巨角”，标着只给 AI，中文栏没搬，falls 不写。
乌兹格的参考图 god_z_butui_03（斯卡索）没挂：他死时祂已倒下几天，画面里没有祂。
伊拉瑟 how 里“护着阵里的人不撤”是照条目护短和暗翼遮住山脊推的，源稿没明写，主会话定留不留。
妲格玛、法埃尔连族和样子都没有，画成兜帽的人，射手不画；两人的 raw 写了 false（画的是箭到以前那一刻）。
雅德维加那一幅的银白叶子是照她专属“叶背一样的银光”画的，豁口在中段不在栗岭，算不算编请看。
卡姆兹第5到6张只有“留守西门”和“白冠城那几年在炎角手里”两句，没写他在不在城里待满这二十几年。
